code.description: The authorization code returned from the /authorize endpoint (required when grant_type=authorization_code).

redirect_uri.description: Must match the redirect_uri used in the /authorize request (required for authorization_code grant).

client_id.description: The Client ID generated when registering the SPA.

code_verifier.description: PKCE code verifier generated in the first step (required for authorization_code grant).

refresh_token.description: Refresh token issued with a previous access token (required when grant_type=refresh_token).
